scanner.name: Scanner
scanner.description: Stationary surveillance node with enhanced detection arrays. Cannot attack but sees farther than most security programs.

patrol.name: Patrol
patrol.description: Automated security routine that follows predetermined routes. Equipped with basic defensive protocols.

bot.name: Bot
bot.description: Autonomous cleaning script with pattern recognition. Wanders unpredictably while scanning for anomalies.

firewall.name: Firewall
firewall.description: Heavily fortified security barrier process. Extremely resilient but slow to respond to threats.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Elite security algorithm with advanced threat detection and powerful attack protocols. Highly dangerous.

virus.name: Virus
virus.description: Hostile malware that corrupts on contact. Doesn't deal direct damage but infects systems with degrading code.

inhibitor.name: Inhibitor
inhibitor.description: Traffic control daemon that throttles unauthorized processes. Slows your execution speed without causing damage.

admin.name: Admin Avatar
admin.description: System administrator's digital enforcer. Heavily armed, relentless, and commands root-level privileges.

system_hop.name: System Hop
system_hop.description: Instantly teleport to any visible blind spot within 6 tiles. Requires line of sight. Perfect for repositioning or escaping.

traffic_masquerade.name: Traffic Masquerade
traffic_masquerade.description: Become completely invisible to all enemies for 5 turns. Walk past hostile programs undetected. Perfect for infiltration.

decoy_swarm.name: Decoy Swarm
decoy_swarm.description: Spawn decoys lasting 8 turns. Enemies investigate and move toward the distraction, leaving your path clear.

buffer_overflow.name: Buffer Overflow
buffer_overflow.description: Devastating melee attack. Extremely powerful but requires adjacent positioning. High risk, high reward.

code_injection.name: Code Injection
code_injection.description: Reliable ranged attack. Moderate damage at safe distance. Your primary offensive tool.

system_crash.name: System Crash
system_crash.description: Critical system error! Damages YOU and stuns nearby enemies for 3 turns. Desperation move when surrounded.

logic_bomb.name: Logic Bomb
logic_bomb.description: Area attack in 2-tile radius. WARNING: Can damage you if detonated too close!

threat_scan.name: Threat Scan
threat_scan.description: Tap into security feeds. Reveals all enemies, their detection ranges, and predicted movement paths for 5 turns.

network_scan.name: Network Scan
network_scan.description: Query network topology. Instantly reveals locations of all cooling nodes, CPU recovery nodes, and ghost nodes.

log_wiper.name: Log Wiper
log_wiper.description: Scrub your activity from system logs and audit trails. Significantly reduces trace level by 30%. Cover your tracks!

antivirus.name: Antivirus
antivirus.description: Run quarantine protocol on your systems. Instantly purges all hostile effects like viruses and movement inhibitors.

denial_of_service.name: Denial of Service
denial_of_service.description: Flood a network segment with overwhelming traffic. Area attack disabling all affected enemies for 5 turns.

memory_leak.name: Memory Leak
memory_leak.description: Blind enemies in 3x3 area for 3 turns. They can't see you but keep moving!

ram_boost.name: Memory Expansion
ram_boost.description: High-capacity memory module. Permanently expands RAM by 4GB - equip more complex exploits simultaneously.

cpu_boost.name: Processing Core
cpu_boost.description: Overclocked processor upgrade. Permanently increases maximum CPU by 20 - survive more damage and operations.

heat_boost.name: Cooling Matrix
heat_boost.description: Advanced thermal dissipation system. Permanently raises heat tolerance by 20 - execute more exploits before overheating.
